rationale: v1 and v2 showed that adding more long exposure produced incremental returns concentrated in a narrow rising regime. v3 leaves the proven risk-on allocation unchanged and tests a materially different source of excess return: a small inverse sleeve during confirmed falling markets that were previously held entirely in cash.

signals.base_risk_state: frozen K200LowTurnoverReentry defaults using only KODEX 200 split-adjusted history
signals.bear_confirmation: using the previous session close only, KODEX 200 close is below its 60-session simple moving average and its 20-session close return is negative
signals.review_schedule: first KRX session of each month and every base-state transition
signals.execution: a changed allocation executes at the current session open from the previous-close signal

execution.kodex_inverse_holding_period_tax: 15.4 percent of the positive minimum of simulated market-price gain and official tax-NAV gain, charged on each sale
execution.cash_distributions: official payment events with 15.4 percent withholding on the taxable amount

research_stop_rule: If v3 fails any development gate, do not test additional allocation or threshold variants on the 2018-2022 panel; move to prospective shadow validation or a genuinely new data domain.
decision_rule: Any development gate failure rejects v3 without opening either sealed period. Passing development opens only the 2023-2024 walk-forward period.
